title: The Grasshopper
writer: Mark McShane, Jerry Belson, Garry Marshall
actors: Jacqueline Bisset, Jim Brown, Joseph Cotten
plot: A young woman's odyssey from innocence to decadence. Hopeful for a career in show business, Christine Adams leaves British Columbia with her boyfriend at age 19. But a detour to Las Vegas leads her into a life that no one would envy.
